These trophies are cumulative in the later versions of the game, which means that beating the game on Proud difficulty will reward you with the Final Mix and Beginner trophies as well.

fields.B:
Before you start the game:
Your choices during the beginning of the game affect how fast you level up. Depending on your answers to Tidus, Wakka and Selphie's questions during your visit to Destiny Islands in the Dive to the Heart, Sora will be assigned one of three profiles: Dawn, which means that you level up faster early on, but start slowing down after level 40; Midday, which means that you maintain a balanced pace from level 1 until level 100; and Dusk, which means that you need more EXP to level up until level 40, but from that point onwards, you level up faster than the other two options. Therefore, the optimal choice when going for level 100 is the Dusk profile. In order to get this profile, you can select the last answer for each question.

Best level up method:
The best known method to level up fast is to farm the Rock Titan battle in Olympus Coliseum. In order to fight this boss without doing the whole tournament, you need to beat the Hades Cup in Time Trial mode*. Then, the "Choose oponent" option will be available.

Recommendations:
- For Sora, turn on the Ars Arcanum ability. Other generic abilities like Critical Plus or MP Haste will also be benefitial. Don't equip any other ability that is activated by pressing Triangle/Y (like Strike Raid or Ragnarok), in order to avoid accidentally using those instead of Ars Arcanum. For Keyblades, I like using the Divine Rose or the Ultima Weapon (if available). Finally, I suggest setting a shortcut for the Aeroga spell.
 - For Goofy: turn on the MP Gift ability and turn off any other ability that consumes MP. That way, he will only consume his MP to restore your MP. Other abilities like MP Haste are useful as well.
 - Also, equip all the EXP accessories you have. You can equip them on Donald and Goofy (their effects apply to the entire party), and give Sora accesories that increase his power instead. You can get two EXP accesories from Synthesis, one from completing 100 Acre Wood and one from defeating the Unknown.

Strategy:
During this fight, make sure to keep Aeroga on all the time. This spell grants you 1 EXP for each hit dealt to the enemy. Start by hitting one of the Rock Titan's foot. Once he falls down, climb up his body until you reach the gap between its heads. Once you're there, you simply need to spam Ars Arcanum on its heads to deal lethal damage to the Titan. Each hit on its head will additionally grant you an extra 1 EXP. During the earlier levels,the Rock Titan is likely to stand up again, but you should be able to remain on top of it and continue hitting its heads without issues. If it knocks you down, simply hit its feet until it falls down again. If you have all 4 EXP accessories, you should be getting 8000 EXP per fight simply from defeating the boss, and an additional 100-200 EXP depending on how many Tech Points you got from Aeroga and hitting the heads.

* If you need to level up before being able to that (or if you don't like fighting the Rock Titan), the second best method to level up fast is by defeating Heartless in three Traverse Town areas: Hallway > Red Room > Green Room (and then, back to the Hallway and repeat).

1. Traverse Town, Dalmatians' House: Return 51 Dalmatians to Pongo and Perdita.
2. Agrabah, Dark Chamber: Chest on a platform in the center of the area, accessible by swimming upstream from the Relic Chamber.
3. Monstro, Chamber 6: Chest on a high platform, near the upper passage to Chamber 5. High Jump makes it easier to reach.
4. Atlantica, Ariel's Grotto: Chest on the upper side of the area.
5. Halloween Town, Research Lab: Examine the bookcase.
